description: This source file defines a static class `AssetCopyIdPolicy` that provides a server-side policy for generating and normalizing identifiers for assets being copied within a system. The class includes a method to assign new globally unique IDs and permit IDs during the copy process, ensuring consistency and uniqueness in the database.

classes.name: AssetCopyIdPolicy
classes.description: A static class implementing server-side ID generation for asset copying to ensure each copied asset has unique identifiers, with logging for observability.

methods.name: ApplyServerGeneratedIdsForCopy
methods.description: Generates new GUID-based unique identifiers for the target asset during the copy process and logs the operation, ensuring that the copied asset has unique IDs that do not conflict with existing database entries.
